title: Brazilian Sweet Potato Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew from Brazil, made with roasted sweet potatoes and a variety of spices.
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with a little bit of oil and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, heat some oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, brown sugar, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes to the pot and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
